verdict.rationale: Sift's Decisions API lets businesses feed back real outcomes (approve/block/cancel) and docs claim the system 'gets smarter the more data it has,' supporting a feedback loop from confirmed outcomes into the model, and human review-then-decide workflows are confirmed by community comments. However, there is no explicit documentation of how review-queue decisions specifically retrain the ML model or update rules, and Workflows/rules are described as a separate 'rules automation platform' rather than something outcome-driven feedback modifies. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the closed-loop mechanism linking review-queue verdicts to model retraining, and how confirmed fraud outcomes update Workflow rules; independent verification of learning effectiveness.
